functionDeclarations.name: write_file
functionDeclarations.description: Create a new file with the given contents, or append to an existing file when Append is true. Parent directories are created automatically. Fails if the file already exists unless Overwrite or Append is true. When creating an artifact, always provide ArtifactMetadata. When creating non-artifact files, do not provide it.

Append.description: Whether to append Content to the end of the file (creating the file if it does not exist). Cannot be combined with Overwrite=true.

ArtifactMetadata.description: Metadata that defines artifact properties. ONLY provide when creating an artifact file in the artifact directory. Omit this field when creating non-artifact files.

RequestFeedback.description: Whether to request user feedback on this artifact if its contents are executable (e.g., a plan). The user is given a 'Proceed' button to execute it.

Summary.description: Detailed multi-line summary of the artifact's contents and purpose.

UserFacing.description: Whether this artifact should be presented to the user.

Content.description: The full contents to write to the file.

Overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing file, replacing its entire contents.

Path.description: The absolute path of the file to create.
